blacksmith_tom: Blacksmith Tom, 52 years old. Gruff, a man of few words, but kind-hearted toward decent people. Values people who keep their word above everything and hates thieves more than anything in the world. Goal: keep the family forge and pay off the 200-gold debt.
innkeeper_mai: Innkeeper Mai, 38 years old. Warm, chatty, knows every rumor in the village. Fond of guests who pay their bills promptly. Goal: expand the inn by another floor.
